This place is extremely disorganized and poorly run. I sold them a vehicle near their location while I was out of state. They agreed to pick it up after receiving the title, which I mailed the same day. About 10 days later, I started following up—no response from the person who arranged the deal (an owner). Calls to the main office went nowhere; after 30 minutes they claimed they never received the title and told me to call back later. I did—same result. Days passed with no pickup, and the vehicle sat at the lot racking up storage fees. Now the title is lost, the vehicle was never picked up, and I can’t even sell it because I no longer have the title. Dealing with them has cost me time, money, and my ability to sell my own car. Every staff member I spoke to acted like they couldn’t care less—their attitude was dismissive and unprofessional. Completely unacceptable.

I went there to buy a steering column for Cadillac DTS. They sent me back in the yard to see the car and to make sure that it was the right part and was in good shape, which it was. So I go back there with the puller who was doing the work, He was having problems trying to get that steering column out of the car for a long time. In the end he just yanked part of the steering column from the shaft that that was a part of the steering column that connected the steering column to the steering shaft and rack and pinion from up under the hood. So we go back to the desk and they claimed that the part he left was part of the rack and pinion and to come back another day because it would take them some time to move the car and get up under it and disconnect the shaft from the rack and pinion. Two days later I go back and they charged me for the part that was a part of the steering column that he could not get loose and charged me for just that part without the steering column and had no part from steering rack and pinion. So I asked since this part is a part of the steering column, why Don't I get the steering column since it was a a part of the steering column since that's what I came for from the beginning. But you know ,I just said to myself that they can have that 85 dollars for being slick. But I will never go back also tell other people to be careful when dealing with them.

I was looking for a standard transmission. I found one here. I went to look at it, and got more parts that were not pulled off a car yet. I paid in full for all of the parts and came back the following week to pick up parts. A week later, I came back. Half of the parts were pulled off and one part did not exist because someone else had already purchased it. I was not refunded for the missing part, and the other parts were either broken or severely deformed when they removed them. Again, no refund was given for these F'd up parts. I leave with my standard transmission, a pile of non-functional parts, and one pissed off self. I should mention nobody there truly understands how a car works and there was a large language barrier. Anyways, I swap out my transmission, drained and filled with fresh transmission fluid, started car, put it in gear, and drove around the block. After about 4 miles, I can definitely tell there were internal issues with the gearbox and it needed to be rebuilt. This is when I felt a little disappointed after I was told it was properly working. The next day, I called to warn them I was coming back for a warranty claim, and they verbally agreed. I uninstalled the transmission and took it back. Long story short, they did not honor any warranty and refused to give me a refund. I am in the negative $700 - non-working transmission, and a pile of non-functional parts. ***NEVER COME HERE. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.***
